comparison_results.evidence_same_signature: Both main and PR #10 fail with database connectivity errors. Main: 'Failed to read startup status from DB', PR #10: 'Can't reach database server'. Both classified as MISSING_ENV_OR_DB infrastructure issues.
comparison_results.failure_count_comparison: Main: 291 failures | PR #10: 292 failures | Difference: +1 (0.3% variance within environmental noise)
comparison_results.evidence_same_count: Essentially identical failure counts. 90% of failing test files are identical between main and PR #10. Pass rates nearly identical (94.52% vs 95.53%).
comparison_results.evidence_db_url: Main: DATABASE_URL not set locally (expected failures with missing env). PR #10: DATABASE_URL set to postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/opsiq_test but connection drops during test execution. Both scenarios result in DB unavailability.
comparison_results.evidence_postgres: Main: Tests assumed to run in local env without PostgreSQL service (no CI service configured in test, only in ci.yml workflow). PR #10: Tests have DATABASE_URL set (service available at init) but drops during execution. Neither scenario has reliable persistent database for test run.

main_baseline.failure_root_cause: DATABASE_URL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_TEST_ENV - Tests require DATABASE_URL, local test environment doesn't provide it
main_baseline.note_from_main_audit: Not introduced by R30 governance changes. Not introduced by main-build-repair. Pre-existing test infrastructure issue.

pr10_results.failure_root_cause: DATABASE_CONNECTION_STABILITY_ISSUE - Database connection succeeds at init but drops during test execution. Connection lost during: test operations, cleanup hooks, audit persistence.
pr10_results.note: Not caused by PR #10 changes. Database connectivity is environmental, not code defect.
